collection.description: A scientist has tested an unfamiliar treatment on several animals and proposes trying it on a gravely ill villager.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A scientist has tested an unfamiliar treatment on several animals and proposes trying it on a gravely ill villager.

choices.label: Offer a carefully explained human trial.
Discuss the ethics of the animal experiments.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The patient consents and improves, but the scientist records that one success proves little.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The patient develops complications, and the trial is stopped.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The scientist discovers that earlier animal results were recorded incorrectly.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: Further studies show inconsistent effects, and the patient receives established care.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The scientist reduces unnecessary suffering and changes the study design.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: An apprentice argues that neither animal nor human lives should be treated as expendable.
